changelog:
Retro Rewind v6.11.1 has been released! This update is required to continue to play online!

# 🏎️ Retro Track Updates 🏎️
```- RMX Choco Island 2 by Kozakura has been added.
- GP Bowser's Castle by LuigiTime202, ISwearChris has been added.
- SW2 DK Spaceport by JealCat, Iggy Ze Koopa has been added.
- SW2 Cheep Cheep Falls by Iggy Ze Koopa has been added.
- SNES Ghost Valley 1 has been removed due to author request.
- N64 Yoshi Valley has been removed due to author request.
- GBA Bowser Castle 2 has been replaced with ZPL's version.
- Wii U Wario Stadium by ISwearChris has been added as a variant of DS Wario Stadium
- SW2 Toad's Factory by Iggy Ze Koopa has been updated to its latest version.
- SW2 DK Pass by Iggy Ze Koopa has been updated to its latest version.
- DS Wario Stadium by ZPL has been updated to its latest version.
- 3DS Rosalina's Ice World by SquireTurnbolt has been updated to its latest release.```


 
# 🏁 Gameplay Updates 🏁
```- Added a new Knockout mode option: KO Royale!
 - Eliminate player's by hitting them with items and attempting to remove all of their balloons! Either finish the race or be the last one standing to win!
- Added the ability to use vanilla item odds when playing offline or in a friend room.
- Added an option to play a modified item recieve sound when you obtain specific power items. Credits to TheBeefBai for making this feature and Ro for the original code!```
 
 
 
# 🙉 Character Updates 🙉
```- Mario (SM64) By DJ Lowgey has been added.
- Lemmy By UltraWario has been added.
- Bowser (Fury) by UltraWario has been added.
- Toadsworth by UltraWario has been added.
- Tuxie by ZoroCarlos has been added.
- Pianta by UltraWario has been added.
- Wario (Metal) by TheBeefBai, ZPL has been added.
- Morton by UltraWario has been added.
- Spike by Cillow The Willow has been added.
- Fuzzy by UltraWario has been added.
- Dolphin by ZoroCarlos has been added.
- Iggy by UltraWario has been added.
- Jaxi by ZoroCarlos has been added.
- Pauline has been changed to TailsCraft and Josei's version.
- Daisy (Swimwear) has been changed to Eydra's version.```



# ⚙️ Other Updates ⚙️ 
```- Users can now add their own character slots, following the guide from the attached document below.
- Local multiplayer now allows users to use custom characters. Please note that remote players and CPUs will still not appear with custom characters.
- Missing track files will no longer result in a crash, rather giving an explicit error telling the user to reinstall when loading into a race.
- Added a new in game badge: Donation badge, either have an active membership to any of the developers or donate a total of over 25 dollars to either one developer or a mix of them to opt in for the badge! If you qualify and are interested, feel free to make a ticket and show proof!
- Added author credits for texture hack creators to tracks that use a texture hacked version of the track.
- Added the ability for user's to add custom sound effects depending on the custom character being used.```

 
# 🐜 Bug Fixes 🐜 
```- Fixed an issue where Grand Prix would skip the award ceremony, causing the GP ranks to not be saved.
- Fixed an issue where only one character voice per character group slot would play for all characters using that slot.
- Fixed an issue where the rank icons would not appear correctly on non English languages.
- Readded Fenixien to the pack.```

Thanks to ImZeraora for significant help with Knockout Royale, as well as Mayro and Mining for some of the custom voice additions!
As always, please report any and all bugs to <#1265514050335412310>
